adaptations: Rust Result maps to a value plus tagged StorageError; failure values are empty placeholders.

read/write preconditions are asserted in every Goose build.
modules.reference_limit: The reference x86 u32 multiply-shift aliases index 8192 to 0 for bits=31,len=16384. The port preserves this optimized-source behavior. 4096-entry sections and storages above 16384 (division path) are outside this failing domain.

adaptations: Rust Option<i32> maps to i32,bool.

Completed palette-id results, saved forms and wire snapshots use frozen arrays. Wire snapshots own their words rather than borrowing the container.
Rust Result/Option map to explicit error tags or value/presence pairs. unpack_ids returns a flag with the palette accessible through the container.

Container read/update preconditions are asserted in all builds; allocation telemetry counts logical backing bytes rather than Rust Vec capacity.
Java/Rust wrapping arithmetic is expressed as unsigned operations and explicit unchecked signed casts, including in debug builds.

The Rust oracle removes only the two declarations importing position/iter.rs; every scalar definition and its original tests remain verbatim.
